apps.name: Fueli
apps.subtitle: AI-powered calorie tracking
apps.versionDescription: First Fueli release using com.welford.fueli. The Release build includes HealthKit support. This IPA is unsigned; users must sign it with an explicit HealthKit-enabled App ID and a compatible provisioning profile. Changing the bundle ID makes this a separate app from the prior com.matteowelford.calclone releases.
apps.localizedDescription: Fueli uses AI to identify food from photos and estimate nutrition, making calorie tracking effortless.

permissions.usageDescription: Used to photograph meals for AI nutrition analysis.
Used to select existing meal photos for nutrition analysis.
